title: Hedgehog
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- body / spines base -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="62" rx="38" ry="30" fill="#8B5A2B"/>
  <!-- spines - individual spikes around top -->
  <polygon points="18,48 26,30 32,46" fill="#A0522D"/>
  <polygon points="30,42 38,22 44,40" fill="#6B3A1F"/>
  <polygon points="44,38 50,18 56,36" fill="#A0522D"/>
  <polygon points="56,38 64,20 70,38" fill="#6B3A1F"/>
  <polygon points="68,44 78,28 84,48" fill="#A0522D"/>
  <polygon points="12,58 20,42 26,56" fill="#6B3A1F"/>
  <polygon points="82,56 90,42 92,58" fill="#6B3A1F"/>
  <!-- face area -->
  <ellipse cx="42" cy="68" rx="26" ry="22" fill="#D2A679"/>
  <!-- lighter belly -->
  <ellipse cx="46" cy="76" rx="18" ry="12" fill="#F0D0B0"/>
  <!-- snout / nose -->
  <ellipse cx="24" cy="70" rx="10" ry="8" fill="#C4956A"/>
  <circle cx="18" cy="70" r="4" fill="#4A2A1A"/>
  <!-- eye -->
  <circle cx="38" cy="62" r="5" fill="#2E1A0E"/>
  <circle cx="39.5" cy="60.5" r="1.8" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <!-- ear -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="52" rx="6" ry="8" fill="#C4956A"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="53" rx="3.5" ry="5" fill="#E8A0A0"/>
  <!-- cheek glow -->
  <circle cx="32" cy="74" r="4" fill="#F5A0A0" opacity="0.6"/>
  <!-- little feet -->
  <ellipse cx="36" cy="90" rx="8" ry="4" fill="#B08050"/>
  <ellipse cx="58" cy="90" rx="8" ry="4" fill="#B08050"/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d="M24,76 Q28,80 32,77" fill="none" stroke="#5A3020" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
</svg>
